actions.name: spellcasting
actions.desc: The sphinx is a 9th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save DC 16, +8 to hit with spell attacks). It requires no material components to cast its spells. The sphinx has the following wizard spells prepared: Cantrips (at will): [[/item .Utk1OQRwYkMkFRD3]]{mage hand}, [[/item .oIzA2MEHwxhtQneU]]{minor illusion}, [[/item .udsLtG0BugXHR2JQ]]{prestidigitation} 1st level (4 slots): [[/item .ghXTfe7sgCbgf1Q8]]{detect magic}, [[/item .3OZnNhunvRtPOQmH]]{identify}, [[/item .z1mx84ONwkXKUZd7]]{shield} 2nd level (3 slots): [[/item .S7VbUetIfVT7B6Eq]]{darkness}, [[/item .SleYkHovQ8NagmeV]]{locate object}, [[/item .zMAWdyc8UVb37BK4]]{suggestion} 3rd level (3 slots): [[/item .15Fa6q1nH27XfbR8]]{dispel magic}, [[/item .XZhdgVK3cLoxNCQl]]{remove curse}, [[/item .gopnZvS0c2jD5FP8]]{tongues} 4th level (3 slots): [[/item .pxpb2eOB6bv4phAf]]{banishment}, [[/item .tEpDmYZNGc9f5OhJ]]{greater invisibility} 5th level (1 slot): [[/item .W4Qx5z0id6da0vqg]]{legend lore}

actions.name: cast a spell
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} casts a spell from its list of prepared spells, using a spell slot as normal.

actions.name: inscrutable
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name monster]]{monster} is immune to any effect that would sense its emotions or read its thoughts, as well as any divination spell that it refuses. Wisdom (Insight) checks made to ascertain the [[lookup @name monster]]{monster}'s intentions or sincerity have disadvantage.

actions.name: magic weapons
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s weapon attacks are magical.

actions.name: teleport
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} magically teleports, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, up to [[lookup @labels.description.range activity=uklF2NbFqnNyuHOp]] to an unoccupied space it can see.
